author: The Infographics Show
description:
A small country in Eastern Europe just crossed the $1 trillion mark, and in the process, it may be shifting the economic center of Europe away from Germany.
This video explores how Poland transformed itself from a post-communist economy into one of Europe’s fastest-rising industrial powers. From the brutal “Shock Therapy” reforms of the 1990s and massive EU infrastructure funding to German manufacturers moving production east, Poland has spent decades building the foundations of a trillion-dollar economy.
We also examine how the war in Ukraine increased Poland’s geopolitical importance, why Warsaw poured money into one of NATO’s largest military buildups, and how foreign investment, nearshoring, and cheap but highly skilled labor helped accelerate its rise.
